Technical SEO.title: AI Overviews Cut CTR by 24.4% in France (3 Month Update)
Technical SEO.summary: Ahrefs tracked sites most exposed to AI Overviews in France and found a 23.1% CTR loss in the first 9 days of their initial August 2026 study, with continued impact as AI Overview share grew. This three-month follow-up quantifies the ongoing organic traffic erosion from AI Overviews in a major European market.

Technical SEO.title: Google Confirms November 2026 Core Update Is Complete
Technical SEO.summary: Google has confirmed the November 2026 core update has finished rolling out, making it actionable for enterprise SEOs to assess ranking shifts and begin recovery analysis.

Technical SEO.title: Google Local Pack No Reviews Bug
Technical SEO.summary: Google is incorrectly displaying 'No reviews' and no star ratings in the local pack for some businesses that do have reviews, though the reviews appear correctly when clicking through to the full listing. Enterprise brands with multi-location presence should audit local pack display for affected listings.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: 9 AI Workflows That Turn Marketing Data Into Content AI Cites
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: CallRail and Guru Media Hub practitioners outlined workflows for identifying what content to publish based on marketing data signals, such as repeated customer questions pointing to missing service pages, and how to measure whether that content earns AI citations. Directly relevant for teams building content strategies aimed at AI answer surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: The Missing Step In Prompt Tracking Was Written Down In 1995
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article argues that competency questions, a knowledge engineering method from 1995, provide a structured framework for defining which prompts matter and what a correct AI answer looks like in GEO tracking workflows. This is relevant for enterprise teams trying to standardize AI search visibility measurement.

AI Search / GEO.title: November 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update Done, AI Overviews, Help Docs, Local & Earnings
AI Search / GEO.summary: This monthly roundup covers the completion of a Google spam update alongside AI Overviews developments, local search changes, and other webmaster-relevant news from November 2026. A useful consolidated reference for enterprise SEOs tracking multiple simultaneous Google changes.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: This data study tracks which domains are most frequently cited across major AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, providing a benchmark for enterprise GEO visibility efforts.

AI Search / GEO.summary: GEO is reported as the fastest-growing service category heading into the holiday season, signaling accelerating enterprise and agency investment in optimizing content for generative AI answer surfaces.
